basic_details.job_title: ICF Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 8 Stock Verifier, Senior Section officer and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Integral Coach Factory, Chennai (Ministry of Railways) is re-engaging retired Non-Gazetted Railway Accounts staff against 8 posts: 1 Sr.Section officer(A), 3 Sr.Stock Verifier / Stock Verifier and 4 Sr.Accountant (erstwhile Accounts Assistant). Only retired Railway staff of the Accounts Department of Zonal Railways/PUs may apply. Applications in the prescribed form go by ordinary post only to DY.FA&CAO/GENERAL, Integral Coach Factory, Chennai and must be received by 02.12.2026 at 17:00 hrs.

age_limit.details: The age limit for all posts is upto 65 years of age as on the date of notification (19.11.2026).

The remuneration so fixed remains unchanged for the term of the contract; Annual Increment/percentage increase and Dearness Allowance are not allowed. TA/DA on official tour, if any, may be allowed as per the entitlement at the time of retirement. important_instructions: Re-engagement is for 1 year or till the validity of the scheme or till further orders, whichever is earlier. On satisfactory performance it can be extended for one more year or till the continuation of the scheme or till attainment of 65 years of age, whichever is earlier. Re-engaged staff shall be discharged immediately on joining of selected candidates from RRBs, CGA, GDCE(RRC) or through Departmental Selection, or for other reasons of administrative convenience on the recommendation of the PHOD/CHOD concerned. The Administration reserves the right to terminate the services at any time if work or conduct is found unsatisfactory or in administrative exigencies. Duty hours will be as prescribed by the Competent Authority as per the working conditions of the category, with a weekly off for one day. Re-engaged staff will not be given financial and D&AR powers and cannot issue any safety certificate, but may recommend suggestions to regular staff/Officers. The retired employee must execute an agreement to abide by all terms and conditions of the re-engagement. The mobile number and e-mail id should not be changed till completion of selection; the administration is not responsible for non-receipt of communication otherwise. ICF reserves the right to reject incomplete or illegible applications and applications without requisite enclosures, signature or latest photograph; no correspondence will be entertained.

content_sections.heading: About ICF
content_sections.text: Integral Coach Factory (ICF), Chennai-38 functions under the Ministry of Railways. This notification is issued by the Dy.FA&CAO/General of its Accounts Department, Shell Division, under Railway Board's letters No.E(NG)II/2024/RC-4/9 dated 15/10/2024 (RBE 96/2024), 31/12/2024 (RBE 115/2024) and 22/09/2026 (RBE 73/2026), which govern the re-engagement of retired Non-Gazetted staff. The re-engagement scheme is valid up to 15.10.2028.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be sent through ordinary post only and must reach on or before the closing date and time, 02.12.2026 at 17:00 hrs. The application is addressed as printed on the form: DY.FA&CAO/ GENERAL, ACCOUNTS DEPARTMENT, SHELL DIVISION, INTEGRAL COACH FACTORY, CHENNAI – 600 038. Download the application format (Annexure I and Annexure II) from the ACCOUNTS WEBSITE/ICF, or use the format enclosed with the notification. Fill in all columns of Annexure I in your own handwriting; all columns are mandatory. Write the post applied for at the top. Fill in Annexure II with the details of postings held during the service period (office, section, designation and dates of joining and relieving). Affix a recent passport size photograph in the space provided and sign legibly in the space provided. Enclose self-attested photocopies of the documents listed under Enclosures. Send the printout with enclosures by ordinary post to the address above so that it reaches by 02.12.2026, 17:00 hrs. The form asks for name, father's name, designation on the day of retirement, office and department from which retired, date of birth, age as on the date of notification, Employee No. and HRMS ID, dates of appointment and retirement, mode of retirement, community, educational/professional qualification, last pay drawn and pay level, PPO number and date, basic pension sanctioned (without deducting commutation pension), permanent and correspondence addresses with PIN code, email ID, mobile numbers and Aadhar number. The applicant also signs declarations on confidentiality, immediate discharge, no pending police or criminal court case, and no D&AR/Vigilance case.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: For all three posts, in terms of the Board's letter dated 20.06.2025, re-engagement of Non-Gazetted posts in pay level 1 to level 9 may be filled by calling volunteers who retired from posts in the same cadre/category up to three level higher than the post against which re-engagement is considered. Volunteers who retired from the same pay level and are found suitable will be given preference over those retired from a higher pay level. Retired Railway Staff who worked in the Accounts Department of Zonal Railways/PUs as Sr.SO(A), in Level-8 & 9 (Pay Level-8, also MACP Pay Level-9). Preference will be given to the retired staff of ICF. Retired Railway Staff who worked as Sr.SV/SV in the Accounts Department of Zonal Railways/PUs, in Level-6 & 7. Preference will be given to the retired Sr.SV/SV of ICF. Retired Railway Staff who worked in the Accounts Department of Zonal Railways/PUs as Sr.Accountant (erstwhile Accounts Assistant) in Level-6. Preference will be given to the retired staff of ICF. The age limit for all posts is upto 65 years of age as on the date of notification (19.11.2026). Applicants should be free from DAR/Vigilance cases and should not have any criminal case/Police case pending before any court of law till the application date. Retired employees covered under the Safety Related Retirement Scheme/Liberalized Active Retirement Scheme for Guaranteed Employment for Safety Staff (LARSGESS) cannot be re-engaged. Re-engagement is subject to the prescribed medical fitness for the category in which they are engaged. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. Candidates should check the official notification for the post-specific eligibility of each post. Monthly remuneration is determined in terms of RBE No.96/2024 dated 15.10.2024: a fixed monthly remuneration arrived at by deducting the Basic Pension from the Pay drawn at the time of retirement. The remuneration so fixed remains unchanged for the term of the contract; Annual Increment/percentage increase and Dearness Allowance are not allowed. Re-engaged employees are not entitled to HRA and Residential Accommodation. Transport Allowance for commuting between residence and place of work is allowed, not exceeding the rate applicable at the time of retirement, and remains unchanged during the term. TA/DA on official tour, if any, may be allowed as per the entitlement at the time of retirement. Paid leave of absence may be allowed at 1.5 days for each completed month of service; leave cannot be accumulated beyond a calendar year or carried forward on extension, and unutilised leave is not paid for at discharge or expiry of the contract.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested photocopy of Service Certificate Self-attested photocopy of Pensioner Identity Card Copy of Pension Payment Order (PPO) (7th CPC Pay Matrix) Recent passport size photograph affixed on Annexure I Annexure II – Details of Posting held during the Service Period, signed

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The suitability/competency of applicants will be adjudged by a Committee, and the integrity aspect will also be checked before re-engagement is permitted. Eligible candidates will be intimated through SMS only, and all SMS communications will come from ACCOUNTS/ICF. Applicants called for document verification should bring all original certificates. The Administration reserves the right to conduct a viva voce in case of necessity. The decision of ICF on eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, selection and allotment of posts is final.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in ICF Recruitment 2026 for retired Accounts staff?
faq.answer: There are 8 posts: 01 Sr.Section officer(A), 03 Sr.Stock Verifier / Stock Verifier and 04 Sr.Accountant (erstwhile Accounts Assistant).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for the ICF re-engagement application?
faq.answer: Applications must be received by 02.12.2026 at 17:00 hrs, sent through ordinary post only.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for ICF re-engagement 2026?
faq.answer: Retired Railway staff who worked in the same post in the Accounts Department of Zonal Railways/PUs can apply; volunteers retired from posts up to three levels higher in the same cadre/category may also be considered.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is upto 65 years of age as on the date of notification, 19.11.2026.

faq.question: Q5. What salary will re-engaged staff get?
faq.answer: A fixed monthly remuneration equal to the Pay drawn at retirement minus the Basic Pension, under RBE No.96/2024; no Annual Increment or Dearness Allowance is allowed.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for ICF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in Annexure I and II in your own handwriting, affix a photograph, sign, enclose self-attested copies of the Service Certificate, Pensioner Identity Card and PPO, and send it by ordinary post to DY.FA&CAO/GENERAL, Integral Coach Factory, Chennai-600038.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: A Committee will adjudge suitability/competency and check integrity, applicants bring original certificates for document verification, and a viva voce may be conducted in case of necessity.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the re-engagement?
faq.answer: It is for 1 year or till the validity of the scheme (upto 15.10.2028) or till further orders, whichever is earlier, extendable by one more year on satisfactory performance up to age 65.

faq.question: Q9. Who is not eligible for re-engagement?
faq.answer: Retired employees covered under the Safety Related Retirement Scheme/LARSGESS, and those with DAR/Vigilance cases or a criminal/Police case pending till the application date, are not eligible.
